en: The postcard depicts an old European town square with a large church featuring a tall spire and arched windows on the left side, likely a historical Lutheran church. To the right, there are classic European-style buildings with multiple windows and gabled roofs. The scene appears quiet and the image is sepia-toned, suggesting it is from the early 20th century. The word 'Wolmar' is printed in red in the upper right corner.
